positive_claim: AM.DIAG.1 sealed: 11 warning categories matching GNU Automake's -W system: Gnu, Gnits, Foreign, Portability, PortabilityRecursive, ExtraPortability, Syntax, Unsupported, Cross, Obsolete, Override (+ All, None, Error meta-categories). WarningCategory::from_arg parses -W arguments including 'no-' negation. defaults_for_strictness returns correct defaults per foreign/gnu/gnits mode. DiagnosticManager::from_config merges default + user categories with warnings_are_errors support. emit_if_enabled gates by category. has_errors detects error-level diagnostics. format_all produces 'file:line: level: message' format. print_all writes to stderr. run_makefile_diagnostics checks 12 known primaries, 6 unimplemented primaries, reserved variable names, duplicate primaries. check_missing_standard_files checks NEWS/README/AUTHORS/ChangeLog (gnu) + COPYING/INSTALL (gnits). Wired to CLI in process_makefile. 10 tests: from_arg(all/none/negated), defaults_for_strictness(foreign/gnu), from_config, emit_if_disabled, emit_if_enabled, format, run_diagnostics_unsupported_primary.
